title: Video of Bill Lear at Bahnsen's labs

tellings.quote: There's even a video of Lear visiting Agnew Bahnsen's labs in North Carolina and witnessing Townsend Brown's gravitator experiments.

plain: Michels says there is film footage, from the 1950s, of the aviation businessman Bill Lear visiting the North Carolina labs of a man named Agnew Bahnson. On that visit, Michels says, Lear watched the "gravitator" experiments of the inventor Townsend Brown, devices Brown hoped would affect gravity. Michels mentions the video himself, without saying where it can be found, as a sign that serious industrial figures were watching this kind of research.
